name: typo3-agentic-toolkit
description: Claude Code plugin for building TYPO3 v13/v14 extensions and site packages with skills, subagents, hooks, LSP, MCP, monitors, workflows and evals. This package only runs the repository's checks; it is not published to npm.
author: Hoja Mustaffa Abdul Latheef <hlatheef@jweiland.net>

scripts.test: npm run test:self && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:sh: shellcheck -S warning hooks/scripts/*.sh monitors/*.sh scripts/*.sh bin/t3 bin/t3-changelog evals/*/fixture.sh
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run lint:sh && npm run validate
